purpose: Benchmark reference labels: blind labels for the eval split, by Claude Sonnet 5.5 subagents (5 clips each, generators mixed per task). Each saw only caption, rubric (7 PC items incl. the universal fatal item) and video frames. sa_score / pc_score computed with teacher/scoring.py.

clips.caption: A large temple bell is struck once with its wooden beam, and a small pebble resting on the bell's shoulder skitters and slides off.
clips.clip_confidence_reason: The pebble motion happens in the last 0.4s and is partly ambiguous.
clips.clip_summary: Close view of a bronze temple bell with a grey pebble on its shoulder. A wooden beam enters from the right at 3.1s and moves across the bell mouth to the central finial by 4.2s, then stays; it never hits the bell wall. The pebble sits still until about 5.4s and then rises upward and drifts toward the beam by 5.7s.
